sitemap.siteUrlRequirement: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL must be a non-local HTTP(S) origin; sitemap is empty without it.

canonical.strategy: metadataBase and canonical activate only from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL

metadata.root: title template, description, Open Graph, Twitter, manifest and icons configured
metadata.publicServices: today-sea, sea, fishing spots, fish, license guide, charters, market and community have source-backed page metadata

headers.Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=(); geolocation is not disabled

csp: NOT_APPLIED: MapLibre, Kakao, media and API origin inventory requires deployment verification before an enforced policy.
hsts: NOT_APPLIED: configure only at the HTTPS production host after domain and redirect verification.

pwa.privateCache: account, admin, onboarding, compose and reservations bypass service-worker cache

verification.build: PASS (58 static pages; private/admin routes are force-dynamic)
